<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sig(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        if r0==63: continue
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['pixels'],(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))))
    return d
def diff():
    p,c = sig(previous_frame), sig(current_frame)
    return {k:(p.get(k),c.get(k)) for k in set(p)|set(c) if p.get(k)!=c.get(k)}

probes = [
  ([(10,29),(21,41)], 'M1 green key->gap c(21,41)'),
  ([(10,29),(20,42)], 'M2 green key->gap c(20,42)'),
  ([(10,29),(21,43)], 'M3 green key->gap c(21,43)'),
  ([(29,10),(40,24)], 'M4 yellow key->gap c(40,24)'),
  ([(29,10),(42,24)], 'M5 yellow key->gap c(42,24)'),
]
for acts, name in probes:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c} for r,c in acts])
    d = diff()
    print(name, '->', 'NO CHANGE' if not d else {k:v[1] for k,v in d.items()})
    if d: break
print('done?', last_action_result.get('done'), 'level_completed?', last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>

def sig(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
        if r0==63: continue
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['pixels'],(min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),max(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))))
    return d
def diff():
    p,c = sig(previous_frame), sig(current_frame)
    return {k:(p.get(k),c.get(k)) for k in set(p)|set(c) if p.get(k)!=c.get(k)}
